title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.06481v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. translated_title: ArcRAG：基于知识图谱的智能体式组合检索
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过在从语料库构建的知识图谱上进行检索来回答问题。然而，检索策略通常围绕其自身构建流程所产生的结构来设计，这些策略在构建方式改变后是否依然有效却很少被测试。我们研究了这种跨构建的可移植性：即一个不依赖特定构建方式的模式、关系名称或重新调优的检索流程，在图谱以不同方式构建时是否仍能保持有效。我们提出了ArcRAG，它在推理时归纳出一个查询局部的图谱接口（即从问题所命名的实体出发可达的节点标签、关系描述符和属性键），据此规划多跳遍历，并以Cypher语言执行和修复这些遍历。我们将MuSiQue、HotpotQA和TriviaQA语料库分别构建为模式引导的图谱（类型化节点、封闭关系集合、来源溯源）和开放信息抽取图谱（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ArcRAG通过在推理时归纳查询局部的图谱接口并规划可修复的多跳遍历，实现了无需任何构建特定调整即可跨不同图谱构建方式保持有效的智能体式组合检索。
en_tdlr: ArcRAG achieves construction-agnostic retrieval by inducing a query-local graph interface at inference time and planning repairable multi-hop Cypher traversals, remaining effective across different knowledge graph construction pipelines without any construction-specific tuning.
